title: Kiss Blue
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tomosaka has loved his best friend Noda for as long as he can remember, but keeps quiet to protect the friendship, especially since Noda is a known womanizer. When Noda learns of Tomosaka's feelings, things turn awkward between them. A two-volume boys' love drama set among university students, with an extra one-shot about a cafe.
life_message: Honest feelings, even risky ones, are worth facing so that a friendship can grow into love.

content.note: Adult boys' love romance between university friends (AniList Boys' Love, MU Yaoi); MangaDex suggestive; explicitness unconfirmed (to verify).
Long-held suppressed feelings and heartbreak (MU Unrequited Love, Heartbreak themes).
MU lists Sexual Harassment Played for Comedy and Cheating/Infidelity; context unknown (to verify).
